<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>agent-self-improve</code></p>

Diagnose recurring communication failures in agent conversations and stage the smallest durable corrections for approval.

## When to use

Diagnose recurring communication failures in supplied or available agent conversations and stage minimal guidance corrections for approval. Use only when explicitly requested.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link agent-self-improve --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link agent-self-improve --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Examples

### Review a frustrating project task

**Prompt**

> Use the agent-self-improve skill to review this project's recent tasks. Focus on why the agent kept asking questions the repository already answered.

**Expected outcome**

A diagnosis tied to conversation evidence and numbered, approval-gated edits for the narrowest guidance layer.

### Evaluate a supplied transcript

**Prompt**

> Use the agent-self-improve skill on this transcript and explain whether the failure came from execution, a skill, or project instructions.

**Expected outcome**

A scoped cause analysis that does not blame prompt wording or edit agent configuration without approval.
